slides.subtitle: AI Applications in Early Disease Detection
paragraphs: According to a study, AI systems have been shown to detect diseases such as cancer and diabetic retinopathy with high accuracy.
bullets: Cancer detection: AI-powered algorithms can analyze medical images and patient data to identify cancerous tissues
Diabetic Retinopathy detection: AI systems can analyze retinal scans to detect early signs of the disease
Mental health issues: AI-powered chatbots can analyze patient conversations to detect mental health issues
